description: This file defines the ResourcesModified event class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It encapsulates information related to modifications of resources within policies, including JSON serialization/deserialization, factory methods, and fields specific to this event type.

classes.name: ResourcesModified
classes.description: Immutable class representing a 'resourcesModified' event in the policy management system, including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of ResourcesModified with different parameter combinations, including deprecated and current versions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a ResourcesModified object from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the modified resources.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Returns the Resources object representing the modified resources.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns an optional JSON representation of the resources, version-dependent.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to this resource within the JSON structure.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ResourcesModified with an updated revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload data (label and resources) to a JSON object builder for serialization.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
